matrix_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2G-R - Simulator Contract Parity and Execution Model Matrix

simulator_dimensions.host_contract: Close of session T (all EOD bars delivered at T close)
simulator_dimensions.authoritative_rule: Agent evaluates market state strictly at T close; no future session data is accessible.
All orders emitted at T close execute at T+1 Open prices.

simulator_dimensions.preview_implementation: Executes in whatever sequence agent emits, or groups sells first depending on harness version
simulator_dimensions.host_contract: Centralized matching engine executes all SELL orders before any BUY orders
simulator_dimensions.reconciliation: Host sell-before-buy ordering is authoritative. Guardian Alpha's causal engine explicitly sorts pending orders so sells precede buys, guaranteeing full simulated cash availability for subsequent buys.

simulator_dimensions.preview_implementation: T+0 instantaneous credit of sell proceeds for buying power within the same morning rebalance
simulator_dimensions.host_contract: T+0 cash availability within the daily execution batch
simulator_dimensions.authoritative_rule: Sell proceeds at T+1 open are immediately credited to cash before T+1 buy orders are filled.

simulator_dimensions.preview_implementation: Orders exceeding available cash fail or are clamped to affordable shares
simulator_dimensions.host_contract: Strict buying power check; orders exceeding cash buffer are clamped or rejected with zero margin debt
simulator_dimensions.authoritative_rule: Buy quantities are strictly clamped: floor((cash - buffer) / (price * (1 + fee + slip))). Cash balance is invariant >= 0.0.

simulator_dimensions.preview_implementation: Supports floats if emitted, but recommends integer shares
simulator_dimensions.authoritative_rule: Both E0 and D2 emit strictly integer share quantities.

simulator_dimensions.preview_implementation: 5 bps for single equities and standard ETFs; 10 bps for 2x/3x leveraged ETFs
simulator_dimensions.authoritative_rule: QLD and SSO incur 10 bps slippage; all standard stocks/ETFs incur 5 bps.

simulator_dimensions.preview_implementation: Single stock position value / Total equity <= 30.0% (max 5 consecutive breach days permitted)
simulator_dimensions.authoritative_rule: No single holding may exceed 30.0% of portfolio equity at rebalance.

simulator_dimensions.preview_implementation: Gross notional leverage <= 1.50x; beta-weighted exposure monitored
simulator_dimensions.authoritative_rule: Both E0 and D2 target <= 0.94x gross notional exposure, well within the 1.50x cap.
